request: Analyze GSE283853 for PMID 40713776 (Large MAF transcription factors reawaken evolutionarily dormant fast-glycolytic type IIb myofibers in human skeletal muscle.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk total-RNA RNA-seq (rRNA-depleted, NextSeq500 2x36) of human iPSC-derived (414C2 iMuSC) myotubes, day 4 after adenoviral infection (S2.10.p1)
final.samples: 12 cultures: pAV-mCherry (control), pAV-MAFA, pAV-MAFB, pAV-MAF, n=3 each (FIG4 C-H)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of adenoviral overexpression of each large MAF transcription factor (MAFA, MAFB, MAF) versus mCherry control on the myotube transcriptome; not an exercise estimand
final.paper_method: CLC Main Workbench Empirical Analysis of DGE (edgeR exact test), genes with zero counts in any sample excluded (S2.10.p1)
final.exercise_component: Exercise/training appears only in the human biopsy analyses (GSE200398 Russian endurance- vs power-trained, resting-state, cross-sectional; dbGaP phs001048 Finnish), which are separate accessions (S2.18.p1, S3.4.p3, DA.p1). GSE283853 contains no exercise, training, or physical-activity factor.

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.10.p1 describes the GSE283853 experiment: myotubes overexpressing MAFA/MAFB/MAF or mCherry, edgeR test, FDR < 0.05. FIG4.A gives DEG counts per MAF vs control. DA.p1 maps GSE283853 to the myotube RNA-seq only; the training-background comparison (S3.4.p3) uses GSE200398, not this series.

checks: DA.p1 names GSE283853 for RNA-seq of human iMuSC-derived myotubes
GEO cell type 'iPS cell-derived myotubes', cell line 414C2, 12 samples pAV-mCherry/MAFA/MAFB/MAF x3, NextSeq 500 match S2.10.p1

ownership.reasoning: Metadata and the CLC export (sample groups pAV-mCherry, pAV-MAFA, pAV-MAFB, pAV-MAF; library names m/a/b/c 1-3) match the paper's myotube experiment.

alignment.reasoning: The deposited CLC export has per-sample columns '<lib> - Expression values'; the prep script keeps those 12 columns and renames them to the library name, which equals the metadata 'description' field ('Library name: m1'). Group taken from title.

final.source: CLC 'Expression values' columns (total read counts per gene) from GSE283853_ProcessedData_quantile_totalcount_normalized_ANOVA.csv
final.paper_input: CLC total read counts analyzed with the edgeR test (S2.10.p1)

matrix.reasoning: The 12 extracted 'Expression values' columns are all integers (file name 'totalcount'); the 'Normalized expression values' (quantile) and 'Transformed values' columns plus group means were dropped. S2.10.p1 runs edgeR on these counts.

candidates.reason_rejected: quantile-normalized, not counts; not the paper's edgeR input

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: GSE283853 is an in-vitro gain-of-function experiment (adenoviral MAFA/MAFB/MAF overexpression vs mCherry in iPSC-derived myotubes). There is no exercise, training, or physical-activity arm, so the requested exercise estimand cannot be identified from this series. The paper's exercise-related data (endurance- vs power-trained biopsies) are in GSE200398/dbGaP, not GSE283853.
design.reasoning: The only factor is the overexpressed transgene (title pAV-*; S2.10.p1; FIG4). A MAF-vs-mCherry contrast is valid for the paper's own question but does not answer how exercise affects gene expression; manufacturing an exercise interpretation would be invalid. Refused at design.

candidates.value: grp MAFA/MAFB/MAF vs mCherry (paper's planned contrasts)
candidates.reason_rejected: transgene overexpression in culture, not an exercise intervention; outside the requested estimand

discrepancies.paper: GSE283853 = MAF overexpression in myotubes (S2.10.p1, DA.p1); training comparison uses GSE200398 (S3.4.p3)
